title: 第12章 以食为天
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

民以食为天。

断水断粮，三天就危险，五天是大限，最多熬不过七天。

所以食物是囤货的重中之重。

谭筝来到食品批发市场后，先去找管理处的工作人员咨询了一下。

“你好，我要大批量全品类食品采购，想要找能够一站式配齐的供货商，你们这有名单吗？可以推荐一下吗？”

“有的，咱们市场里有几家专门做全品类供货的大户，覆盖生鲜、粮油、副食、干货等所有品类，支持大单批发和统一配送。档口号就在这上面，你直接过去洽谈就行。”

“好的，谢谢。”

谭筝把几家供货商都逛了一遍，最终敲定了——满仓批发。

这是市场里资历最久的全品类供货商，也是工作人员推荐的首选。

店内品类覆盖极全，直接对接各大生产厂家，没有中间商，大单拿货价格十分实惠；自建大型恒温仓库与完整冷链，干货防潮、生鲜冻品保鲜都有保障。

老板曹顺为人爽快，做大单经验足，出货速度快，还能安排专车统一配送，售后也靠谱。

囤货优先选米面、杂粮，因为它们能快速为人体提供热量，撑起最基本的生存需求。

“老板，大米和面粉各两万斤，土豆和红薯各一万斤，玉米、小米、山药、芋头各五千斤，燕麦、荞麦、薏米、黑米……还有黄豆、绿豆、红豆、黑豆……各三千斤。”

大米、面粉是第一优先级的主力主食，需求量最大；土豆、红薯作为高淀粉薯类，既能当主食又能做菜，饱腹感强，作为第二梯队，用来轮换主食、丰富餐食。

玉米、小米、山药、芋头兼顾营养、口感与食疗作用，属于重要辅助口粮，填补主食品类空缺。

最后燕麦、荞麦、薏米、以及各类豆类，主要作用是优化膳食结构、变换口味，并非刚需主力，所以可以少备一些。

“好的谭老板！这边算下来，批发价一共二十五万。”

“嗯。”

谭筝表示没问题，继续往里走。

食用油是生存刚需，既能补充热量、提供人体必需营养，助力吸收食物养分，也能丰富饭菜口感，还可兼顾照明、润滑等应急用途，必须足量储备。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Food is the most important thing for the people.

Without water or food, three days would be dangerous, five days would be the limit, and the maximum would not last seven days.

So food is the top priority when stocking up.

After Tan Zheng arrived at the food wholesale market, she first consulted the staff at the management office.

"Hello, I want to purchase a large amount of all kinds of food, and I want to find a supplier who can provide it in one stop. Do you have a list? Can you recommend it?"

"Yes, there are several large companies in our market that specialize in supplying all categories, covering all categories of fresh food, grains and oils, non-staple food, dry goods, etc., and support wholesale of large orders and unified distribution. The stall slogan is above, you can just go there to negotiate."

"Okay, thank you."

Tan Zheng visited several suppliers and finally settled on a wholesale deal with a full warehouse.

This is the longest-standing full-category supplier in the market and is also the first choice recommended by staff.

The store has a full range of categories and is directly connected to major manufacturers. There are no middlemen, and the price for large orders is very affordable. It has a self-built large-scale constant-temperature warehouse and a complete cold chain, which guarantees the moisture-proofing of dry goods and the preservation of fresh and frozen products.

The boss, Cao Shun, is a cheerful person, has extensive experience in making large orders, has fast shipping speed, can also arrange special vehicles for unified delivery, and has reliable after-sales service.

When stocking up, give priority to rice, noodles, and grains, because they can quickly provide calories to the human body and support the most basic survival needs.

"Boss, rice and flour are 20,000 jins each, potatoes and sweet potatoes are 10,000 jins each, corn, millet, yam, taro are 5,000 jins each, oats, buckwheat, barley, black rice...and soybeans, mung beans, red beans, black beans...are 3,000 jins each."

Rice and flour are the first priority staple foods, with the largest demand; potatoes and sweet potatoes, as high-starch potatoes, can be used as both staple food and cooking, and have a strong sense of satiety. As the second echelon, they are used to rotate staple foods and enrich meals.

Corn, millet, yam, and taro take into account nutrition, taste, and therapeutic effects. They are important auxiliary food rations and fill the gap in the staple food category.

Finally, oats, buckwheat, barley, and various types of beans are mainly used to optimize the meal structure and change the taste. They are not the main ones, so you can prepare less.

"Okay, Boss Tan! Calculated here, the wholesale price is a total of 250,000."

"Yeah."

Tan Zheng said it was no problem and continued walking inside.

Edible oil is a necessity for survival. It can not only replenish calories, provide essential nutrients for the human body, help absorb food nutrients, but also enrich the taste of meals. It can also be used for emergency purposes such as lighting and lubrication, so it must be stored in sufficient quantities.
